title: Bug triage
audience: For small teams and solo developers without a full issue tracker.
description: A bug triage table your AI keeps. Paste a report or an issue and it files it by severity in Amber Notes.
tagline: Every bug in one table, by how much it hurts.
note:
Bug triage

Every bug report in one table, sorted by how much it hurts. Paste a report and your AI files it.

<!-- pane-table: Bug=text; Severity=choice P0|P1|P2|P3; Area=text; Status=choice New|Confirmed|In progress|Fixed|Won't fix; Reported=text; Link=text -->
| Bug | Severity | Area | Status | Reported | Link |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Severity
- **P0:** data loss, a security hole, or everyone is blocked. Drop everything.
- **P1:** a main flow is broken for many people. This week.
- **P2:** broken, but there's a workaround. Schedule it.
- **P3:** polish. When there's time.

## Details

prompt.default: Use my Amber Notes note "Bug triage". When I paste a bug report, file it: read the rules under "Severity" in the note, then add one row with log_table_row with a short Bug title, Severity by those rules, the Area, Status New, Reported as today's date, and the Link if there is one. If the report has steps to reproduce, add them under "Details" with append_to_note under a "###" heading with the bug title. To change a status, read the note with read_note and update the row with edit_note.
prompt.claudeCode: Use my Amber Notes note "Bug triage". When I paste a bug report or a GitHub issue (read it with gh issue view), file it: read the rules under "Severity", add one row with log_table_row (a short Bug title, Severity, Area, Status New, Reported as today's date, Link), then look through this codebase for the likely cause and add the steps to reproduce and the files involved under "Details" with append_to_note, under a "###" heading with the bug title. When we fix one, set its Status to Fixed with edit_note.

values.Bug: Export crashes on notes with images

args.text:
### Export crashes on notes with images
1. Open a note with two or more photos.
2. Choose Export as PDF.
3. The app quits.

Likely cause: images are loaded at full size before they're scaled.

## Details
### Export crashes on notes with images
1. Open a note with two or more photos.
2. Choose Export as PDF.
3. The app quits.

Likely cause: images are loaded at full size before they're scaled.
